limits: This is not each material or formulation in existence. Families without grade-specific data are explicitly untested
Manufacturer typical coupon data are not part allowables, measured headphone data or proof of long-term strength
Same geometry, fixed Poisson ratio, ideal fixture and linear elastic assumptions retained; no large-deformation, creep, fatigue, print anisotropy, impact or hinge transfer
Thickness ratio is an ideal rectangular strip EI proxy, not a redesigned guide or validated complete band
Foam points are not enough to build a constitutive curve. No fitted curve was invented
No cheapest-material, skin suitability, universal sensory preference or novelty/patent claim
Supplier price, Indian stock and delivery not investigated for these materials
